svg.title: Reports and calculation rules
svg.desc: Sample reports: 42 of 50 due tasks completed, 84 percent; six current pending approvals. Invoice counts: draft two, sent three, paid five, overdue one, void one. Calculation rules are printed beside each measure.

g.text: Rule: completed tasks due in period ÷ all tasks due.
Period: 01–30 Nov 2026. Zero due tasks shows “No data”.
Rule: count invoices by current state.
Northstar Studio is fictional. Sample data.
